profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Rewards Network
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Capital One, I contribute to the development and enhancement of distributed systems on AWS. My work focuses on leveraging my expertise in Data Engineering and Backend technologies to drive data transformations in line with our conversion goals.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. My professional journey has encompassed roles in backend development, test automation, and distributed systems, with a strong focus on building scalable and robust infrastructure across diverse industries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed comprehensive ETL pipelines utilizing AWS Lambda, Eventbridge, and Glue for efficient data ingestion and transformation.  
• Employed Databricks for batch jobs and data profiling, enhancing data quality and accessibility.  
• Wrote jobs in Spark using both Python and Scala, ensuring robust and scalable data processing solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · Scala · Databricks Products · AWS Lambda · AWS Glue

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated closely with product managers to improve and maintain core Scala-based backend services for Apixio's medical coding solution.
Interfaced with different data sources like Kafka, Redis, ElasticSearch, SQL databases.
Used Python for data manipulation, transformation, and validation of microservices functionality.
positions.insights: Skills: Scala · Redis · Apache Kafka · Elasticsearch · Cassandra · Java · Python (Programming Language) · Pandas · Polars · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of the team assigned to work on testing and assuring the quality of the Audio system of Facebook's Portal platform. Worked with embedded Android distributions to perform and create new automated tests that measure various qualities of the audio produced.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Android Testing · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the Automation team at XCOM Labs. Initially responsible for creating automated test frameworks to test XCOM's proprietary edge mesh network for cellular devices.
Created a testing framework for XCOM’s 60GHz Wi-Fi solution, that involved making custom layer2 packets and running diagnostics on the flow of packets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer responsible for adding and implementing features to a Python tool that manages VM instances running on a Linux machine with KVM as the hypervisor. Also responsible for developing Ansible playbooks that configure blank PC's and enable them to run this system.

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.position: Head of the Web Development Committee · Aug 2015 - Present
organizations.description: Helped manage and improve SHPE UIUC's website. Created a content management system for E-Board members to edit the pages of their committees.
